evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We evaluated seven general-purpose LLM configurations on three direct-response tasks: estimating 0--10 cm SOC concentrations for 308 Australian paddocks under two information conditions, calculating SOC stock in 120 matched scenarios, and comparing 300 paddock pairs.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Six configurations were highly accurate in stock calculations using equation-native units without coarse fragments, but accuracy declined with physically equivalent alternative units.
